question: Into what locus does the radiance situated in the throat-cavity attain absorption?
premises: A radiance is situated in the throat-cavity.
This radiance moves toward a state of absorption.
The absorption occurs in the brahma-aperture.
inference: The radiance located in the throat-cavity reaches dissolution in the brahma-aperture.
uncertainties: The gender agreement of gatā with an implied feminine subject is inferred from context.
plain_english: The radiance situated in the cavity of the throat has gone to absorption in the brahma-aperture.
